name: Apigee Edge
description_en:
Apigee Edge manages backend APIs through configurable API proxies. Its documentation distinguishes the client-facing ProxyEndpoint from the backend-facing TargetEndpoint, allowing policy and connection configuration on separate request/response legs. A proxy bundle’s configuration revision is distinct from the public API version seen by clients.

This record covers Edge Public Cloud and Private Cloud. It does not substitute current Apigee X/hybrid packaging or Google Cloud pay-as-you-go prices. The actual Edge documentation is hosted on apigee.com while the existing catalog identity is google.com; exact source provenance is recorded for the coordinator’s cross-domain registry.
description_zh:
Apigee Edge 通过可配置 API 代理管理后端 API。文档区分面向调用方的 ProxyEndpoint 与面向后端的 TargetEndpoint，分别配置请求／响应两段的策略和连接。代理包配置 revision 与客户端看到的公开 API 版本不同。

本档案限定 Edge Public Cloud 和 Private Cloud，不替换为当前 Apigee X／hybrid 打包或 Google Cloud 按量价格。真实 Edge 文档在 apigee.com，而既有目录身份为 google.com；已为协调侧跨域登记保留精确来源证据。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure the app-facing proxy separately from the backend target connection.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将应用侧代理与后端目标连接分别配置。

core_features.explanation_en: Track numbered proxy configurations independently of public API versions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 独立于公开 API 版本跟踪编号代理配置。

core_features.explanation_en: Edge deployment modes assign different infrastructure and administrative responsibilities.
core_features.explanation_zh: Edge 部署模式对应不同基础设施及管理责任。

en: Pilot an Edge proxy over a harmless backend with explicit request/response expectations.

zh: 使用无害后端试点 Edge 代理，并明确请求／响应预期。

items.en: Proxy revision rollback does not roll back backend data or public API semantics.

items.en: Different basepaths can leave two revisions deployed after override.
items.zh: 不同 basepath 可能使 override 后保留两个已部署 revision。

sections.title_zh: 选择实际 Edge 部署
sections.en: The overview describes vendor-operated Public Cloud and customer-operated Private Cloud, with feature differences. Private Cloud makes installation, upgrades and maintenance the customer’s responsibility. Determine the intended product/version before planning dependencies. The page’s general account categories do not establish a currently purchasable free offer or the terms of a particular customer contract.
sections.zh: 概览区分厂商运行的 Public Cloud 与客户运行的 Private Cloud，且功能不同。Private Cloud 的安装、升级、维护由客户负责。应先确定产品／版本再规划依赖；页面的一般账户类别不证明当前可购买的免费方案或具体合同条款。

sections.title_en: Check both client and target policies
sections.title_zh: 检查调用侧与目标侧策略
sections.en: ProxyEndpoint defines how clients reach the proxy and can attach security/quota policies. TargetEndpoint defines backend routing, protocol and connection security, with response processing. A proxy can be defined in the UI, imported as a bundle or managed through APIs. Test one harmless backend and compare allowed, denied and backend-failure responses rather than treating successful import as effective protection.
sections.zh: ProxyEndpoint 定义客户端访问及安全／配额策略；TargetEndpoint 定义后端路由、协议、连接安全和响应处理。代理可经 UI、导入包或管理 API 定义。应使用无害后端比较允许、拒绝及后端失败响应，不能将导入成功视为保护已生效。

sections.title_en: Import, revision and deployment are separate
sections.en: A proxy must be deployed to an environment before invocation. Inspect organization/environment/revision state when diagnosing failure. Deploying an earlier revision can restore proxy configuration, but does not restore backend data or public API semantics. Import success alone is insufficient.
sections.zh: 代理部署到环境后才能调用。排错应检查组织／环境／revision 状态。重新部署旧 revision 可恢复代理配置，不恢复后端数据或公开 API 语义；仅导入成功不足。

sections.title_en: A rollout option has a basepath condition
sections.title_zh: 切换选项有 basepath 条件
sections.en: Override retains the old revision while deploying the new one; delay allows older transactions to finish. Different basepaths can leave both revisions deployed. Rehearse routing and observed state; the documented seamless mode is not a measured zero-error guarantee.
sections.zh: Override 在部署新 revision 时保留旧版，delay 等待旧事务。不同 basepath 可能使两版均已部署。应演练路由及状态；文档无缝模式不是实测零错误保证。
